description: Release-scoped normalization policy. The existing staging certification (security/scripts/build-staging-certification.js) remains the environment-level authority and is consumed here as an INPUT; this policy states how each of its findings maps onto a RELEASE-scoped verdict. There is exactly one authoritative release verdict, produced by security/release/build-release-evidence.js. This file never downgrades a finding generically - anything not explicitly classified below fails closed.
principles: STAGING_VERIFIED is release-scoped: it asserts that the exact frozen candidate deployed to staging passed every applicable release-content and operational gate. It does NOT assert that every environment capability required for production is enabled.
An UNKNOWN or unclassified certification finding fails closed: stagingVerifiedBlocking defaults to true until a human classifies it.
An OPERATIONAL_FAILURE in a required control blocks STAGING_VERIFIED. Missing evidence is never a pass.
Environment-scoped findings may coexist with STAGING_VERIFIED only where explicitly marked stagingVerifiedBlocking=false, and such findings still block production promotion.
This policy does not reinterpret the suspended native UI automation control. That control keeps its own policy file (security/release/native-ui-automation-policy.json) and is consumed unchanged.

defaultForUnclassifiedFinding.rationale: Fail closed. A finding nobody has classified must not be able to pass a release by default.

leaked_password_protection.rationale: HaveIBeenPwned leaked-password checking requires the Supabase Pro plan; the KScan organization is on the free plan and the setting returns HTTP 402. This is a property of the environment's subscription, not of any release candidate's content - no change to the candidate can clear it, and blocking STAGING_VERIFIED on it would make the state permanently unreachable while telling us nothing about the release. It remains a hard production-promotion blocker because production genuinely requires the control.
leaked_password_protection.ownerAction: Upgrade the staging/production Supabase plan, enable leaked-password protection, and rerun certification.

native_ui_automation.rationale: Consumed unchanged from its own policy file, which currently reads SUSPENDED / required_for_release=false / NOT_REQUIRED_BY_CURRENT_POLICY. This entry exists only to record the delegation so a reader does not conclude the control was silently dropped. If that policy re-arms the control, this entry must not be used to keep it non-blocking.

requiredControlNotes: An OPERATIONAL_FAILURE or BLOCKED result in any control listed here blocks STAGING_VERIFIED. Smoke categories that are legitimately unsupported in staging report NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason and are not in this required list; they must never be reported as PASS.
